description: Step-by-step instructions for a scheduled routine: morning_report (7:00 daily), triage_comments (every 3 hours in the day), pick_winner (Trial Reels), plan_week (Sundays), weekly_results (Mondays: what worked and 2 drafts like the best post), send_reports (1st of the month: client reports as mail drafts), triage_deals (brand email from Gmail, twice a day), pitch_brands (brand pitches as Gmail drafts, weekly), import_history (once, from Publer) or product_week (once: product links into a week of posts). A routine's standing prompt is "call routine_get with this name and follow it"; routines_suggest says which fit.

source.description: For import_history: where the history is now (default Publer)
